# Project Smoke Detector — Addendum 001

**Document:** PSD-ADD-001
**Revision:** 0
**Status:** Issued with RFP
**Date:** 2026-08-12

## Changes

1. In PSD-RFP-001 Section 3, “complete facility” includes the temporary
   incident-command room shown on PSD-ARC-101.
2. Replace the firestopping note on PSD-ARC-101 Detail 6 with “tested system
   and access provisions coordinated with the listed penetration assembly.”
3. No change is made to the smoke-management objectives in PSD-FLS-001 or to
   the equipment duty requirements in PSD-M-201.

This Addendum is part of the issued proposal package. It does not revise
unidentified notes or create a general precedence rule beyond the affected
items above.
